messages:
zoe.docs: Heads-up: PR #2677 shows the /v1/rerank response examples using `scores` normalized to [0,1] (e.g. 0.87). Runtime actually returns raw model logit scores (can be negative and >1). This mismatch broke a customer dashboard that expects 0-1.

zoe.docs: Example from the PR: {"items":[{"id":1,"score":0.87}]} but actual runtime returns {"items":[{"id":1,"score":-2.34}]}

ali-ml: Confirmed. We moved away from post-normalizing scores in the rerank pipeline to preserve raw model outputs for downstream calibration. Docs should reflect that change.

pete-sdk: Go/TS SDKs surfaced this because example UI snippets clamp scores to 0..1. Type mismatch plus silent clamping caused misleading results. We should update SDK snippets and maybe add a helper to map logits->probabilities if teams want 0-1.

anna-api: Action: I'll update the OpenAPI response schema description for `score` to note "raw model score (logit); may be negative or unbounded" and add an example showing a negative value.

zoe.docs: I'll update the API reference examples (curl/js/py) and add a short "Interpreting rerank scores" subsection recommending softmax or min-max normalization with example code snippets. Will also add a deprecation note about previous normalized examples to avoid customer confusion.

pete-sdk: I'll open a SDK PR adding an optional helper function RerankScores.ToProbabilities(scores []float64) and update the JS snippet in docs. ETA: 5h.

ci-bot: CI: docs PR #2677 lint OK; integration tests failing: dashboard-integration/TestRerankScoreHandling (see https://ci.internal/rdw/2677/job/99).

zoe.docs: Thanks 44d I'll include a migration blurb: "If you relied on 0..1 scores, please apply a normalization step or pin an older SDK/docs snapshot."

anna-api: Plan recap: 1) OpenAPI schema + example update (anna-api) 2) docs update + migration note (zoe.docs) 3) SDK helper + snippet update (pete-sdk) 4) post-merge smoke check on dashboard integration tests. Target: tomorrow AM.

pete-sdk: Sounds good. Will add unit tests showing raw -> normalized transforms. Ping when docs patch is up.
